g0.rationale: EXCLUDED ON TWO INDEPENDENT CHARTER GROUNDS. Ground 1 — pre-shampoo-only treatment. The frozen directions place the product on UNWASHED hair and sequence the shampoo AFTER the rinse: 'Olaplex Hair Perfector N°3 großzügig im ungewaschenen, handtuchtrockenen Haar auftragen und durchkämmen. Mindestens 10 Minuten einwirken lassen (für einen intensiveren Effekt: über Nacht). Anschließend auswaschen, danach wie gewohnt shampoonieren und Conditioner/Kur auftragen.' §2.1's eligibility definition requires application AFTER cleansing; this product is applied BEFORE it, and the charter's Excluded list names 'pre-shampoo-only treatments' explicitly. Ground 2 — bondbuilder catalog category with a specialist protocol. The charter's Excluded list names 'products in the bondbuilder catalog category with specialist protocols (Olaplex-style)'; this is the product that phrase was written about. Either ground alone is sufficient; both hold. §2.2's multi-use test was also run for completeness: the only alternative stated mode is 'für einen intensiveren Effekt: über Nacht', which is an overnight extension of the same pre-shampoo application and is itself a charter-excluded leave-on form. Under §2.2 step 4, no mode qualifies → `excluded_product_form`, with the reason recorded. The product's own directions place the ordinary mask slot AFTER it ('danach wie gewohnt shampoonieren und Conditioner/Kur auftragen') — the product is explicitly not the Kur in its own routine.

boundaryEvidence.purpose: Per §2.1 and G0, an excluded row stays visible as boundary evidence and a stress case, and is never forced through the mask ontology. The observations below are E1 formula facts recorded for traceability. They are NOT a classification, they are NOT a partial profile, and no comparison value is derived from them.

tailMarkerIfComputed.note: Computed for the record only. No §3.1 anomaly would apply (rank 7 > 3, with Cetearyl Alcohol @4 and Behentrimonium Methosulfate @5 preceding).

namedBondChemistry.note: The token is present at rank 2, above the computed marker at 7, and is the exact species lexicon family 6 names as the canonical maleate route. Had this product been eligible, bond_route would have been `maleate` and repair_support_level would have been the cohort's only `high` besides #04. It is NOT eligible, so no such value is emitted. R7's standing caveat would have applied in full: the maleate mechanism has peer-reviewed structural investigation behind it (Michael-acceptor addition to free thiols, IR/Raman/SEM on bleached hair keratin), but the circulating '+38% intact disulfide bonds' figure traces to a supplier blog citing an un-locatable study and is unusable.

boundaryEvidence.archetypeGapConfirmation: This capture confirms rather than contradicts Nick's accepted archetype-4b gap ruling. The calibration proposal noted that no drugstore-available MASK carries maleate bond chemistry; Olaplex No.3 shows the chemistry exists in the German market but exclusively in an excluded product form sold outside dm/Rossmann/Müller. Archetype 4b therefore remains genuinely unfilled by any eligible product, and the cohort's only qualifying named bond route is #04's gluconamide.

tailMarker.anomalyNote: Recorded as boundary evidence only. This product is excluded at G0 and no classification rests on this marker.  ||  PLAUSIBILITY ASSESSMENT (R2, §3.1.1, added under v0.2) - recorded for completeness only; the product is excluded at G0 and no classification rests on it. PLAUSIBLE on the credited reading: CETEARYL ALCOHOL @4, BEHENTRIMONIUM METHOSULFATE @5 and CETYL ALCOHOL @6 outrank PHENOXYETHANOL @7, and the product is a conventional O/W emulsion with Water @1. Recorded counter-reading: four further cationic species (STEARAMIDOPROPYL DIMETHYLAMINE @10, QUATERNIUM-91 @11, CETRIMONIUM METHOSULFATE @13, CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE @14) sit below the marker, and a reviewer who counted those as architecture-establishing would set `unresolved`. Because this record produces no profile, the two readings have no consequence and the prong is recorded rather than adjudicated.

bondRoute.note: Recorded as BOUNDARY EVIDENCE, not as a classification. The product is excluded at G0, receives no profile, and this value gates nothing. It is retained because the cohort was frozen partly to test whether maleate chemistry exists in the German market at all, and because a reader comparing this record with #02 and #07 should be able to see all three bond outcomes — a qualifying token in an INELIGIBLE product (here), a qualifying token BELOW the tail in an eligible product (#02), and bond POSITIONING with no token at all (#07).
